preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 4 and 1000.
The number of roads k must be at least n - 1 and at most 2n - 2.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n
preconditions.description: The cities a, b, c, and d must be distinct and within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: a != b and c != d and a != c and a != d and b != c and b != d
preconditions.description: The cities a, b, c, and d must be distinct from each other.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(v) == n and len(u) == n and v[0] == a and v[-1] == b and u[0] == c and u[-1] == d)
postconditions.description: If it's impossible, output -1; otherwise, output two valid paths of length n starting and ending with the specified cities.
Both paths must contain n distinct cities.

postconditions.expression: len(set((v[i], v[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1)) | set((u[i], u[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1))) <= k
postconditions.description: The total number of distinct roads used in both paths must not exceed k.
